howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.heading: From design file to finished part

inlinePhoto.caption: GEarheads manufacturing subteam — mid-run on the industrial mill

howItWorks.body:
Send a design file — Onshape, DXF, STL, or a sketch. We check it over, queue it up, and catch fit issues early.

CAM, slicing, quality checks — no G-code on your end. Pick up at the next event or our shop, usually within three to ten days.

services.title: CNC Milling
services.description: Three in-house mills cut aluminum, polycarbonate, HDPE, and plywood. Send an Onshape or DXF file and we handle CAM, cutting, and quality checks.
highlights: Three mills on-site: MPCNC, 6×6 industrial, large-format PrintNC
Cuts aluminum, polycarbonate, HDPE, and plywood
CAM setup handled by GEarheads — no G-code needed

services.title: 3D Printing
services.description: The fastest way from CAD sketch to working part, in PLA, PETG, or TPU. We handle slicing, check every print, and re-print same-day if something's off.
highlights: PLA, PETG, and TPU in stock
Slicing and support strategy handled by GEarheads

services.title: Laser Cutting
services.description: Acrylic, Delrin, wood, fabric, and foam cut to tight tolerances — field elements, bumper guides, robot shells. We'll etch logos and numbers into panels too.
highlights: Cuts acrylic, Delrin, wood, foam, and thin sheet material
Etches logos, team numbers, and labels into panels
Accepts SVG and DXF; raster-to-vector conversion available

services.title: Plotter Printing
services.description: Vinyl plotting and large-format printing for decals, pit signage, and portfolio covers — graphics as sharp as the engineering behind them.
highlights: Vinyl cuts and large-format prints for decals and signage
Logo sizing, color matching, and material guidance
Engineering portfolio covers and presentation inserts

partners.name: Pack-a-Punch
partners.description: Needed a drivetrain plate with precision holes their shop couldn't run. We milled it and tightened their CAD tolerances for a clean fit.

partners.name: Random Engineers
partners.description: Needed a custom intake arm — nothing off-the-shelf fit. We printed a few iterations over two days until it cleared the frame.

partners.name: Tundrabots
partners.description: Needed official-dimension field panels without buying a second kit. We cut and delivered in a week for full-field practice.

partners.name: Hapabots
partners.description: Worked with us for several seasons, from plotter graphics to getting their own X-Carve running. Now part of DIY-CNC, fabricating on their own.
